gulf-p1-datavolt-nebius-oxagon-20261021.date_semantics: The dateline and page JSON-LD datePublished are 21 October 2026 (14:38 UTC; dateModified 14:55 UTC the same day). The present-tense statement that the initial 100 MW is currently under construction is the operator's own statement as of that day, so 21 October 2026 is used as the observation date. gulf-p1-datavolt-nebius-oxagon-20261021.summary: DataVolt's release, datelined Riyadh, 21 October 2026, announces a preliminary framework agreement between HUMAIN, DataVolt and Nebius for data-centre capacity at the planned AI giga campus in NEOM's Oxagon. Nebius would take up to 50 MW, described as half of the initial 100 MW currently under construction as part of the first phase's planned 360 MW. The release says the framework comes six weeks after construction was announced as having started, and that the allocated capacity is expected to become operational in phases from Q4 2027. DataVolt's CEO says that at Oxagon 'we are building at scale'. The agreement is preliminary and the operating date is a forecast; no part of the campus is said to be complete or operating.
gulf-p1-datavolt-nebius-oxagon-20261021.title: HUMAIN and DataVolt Advance AI Infrastructure Framework with Nebius for planned Giga campus in NEOM's Oxagon (DataVolt breaking news, 21 October 2026)
